summary: Can-Fite BioPharma Ltd. filed a Form 6-K furnishing notice of its 2026 Annual General Meeting of Shareholders to be held on May 28, 2026. The agenda includes re-election of a director, increase of authorized share capital, approval of option grants to executives, and re-appointment of auditors. Neither the filing nor its attachments disclose any merger, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, or other special-situation event. This is a routine proxy solicitation notice for an annual meeting, not a special situation. Therefore, this filing does not trigger any deal-arbitrage or risk-arb analysis.
